checks.detail: studio ✓ desktop ✓ — spec ambiguity: The spec says 'the blockquote's text is the selection'. checks.title: blygger-desktop round trip: partial-transclusion selector
checks.detail: TransclusionRef has no selector. Readers may ignore it (§10.3), so this is not a reader failure; but desktop stores imported lineage, and any re-emission or local re-check (§10.2 MAY) from that store sees partial quotes as whole ones — the shape of the loss seen on the Blynger fork.
